questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Japanstudier - så er det fedt at komme til Japan

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Der var en del procedurer i Japan, men jeg fik en velkomstpakke, hvor der var information om det meste. Procedurerne var dog besværlige alligevel.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Velkomstpakke, og jeg kunne skrive til international division, hvis jeg havde nogle spørgsmål.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik bare tildelt et kollegieværelse.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Mange andre internationale studerende boede også i "Global Village".

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er dog nogle mærkelige regler, hvor drenge og piger er opdelt i hver deres sektion, og der var ikke så mange steder man kunne mødes og hænge ud eftersom det var forbudt at have det modsatte køn på besøg (selvom de lidt så gennem fingrene med det nogle gange)...

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Relativt nemt via et excel ark. Der er også en oversigt over de fleste kurser.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man vælger kurser på et excel ark. Så sender man arket. I de første uger kan man godt droppe og vælge nye fag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var en guide

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Meget

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare følg instrukserne

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ville gerne have haft mere japansk undervisning siden jeg studerer Japanstudier. Ved godt at det dog er en KU-plads.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Lidt nemmere end KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget var stadig online, så svært at sammenligne. Men man tager flere fag, op mod 6-7 fag pr. semester.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Osaka in Modern Japanese Literature
Negotiation Workshop
Introduction to Japanese Law
Second Language Learning with Online Resources
 A Glimpse at Japanese Arts
Japanese JA300

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Osaka in Modern Litterature. Interesting course with a great professor. Is also fluent in English - some of the other professors lacked a bit...

Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ekstra forsikringer. På et tidspunkt havde jeg vist 3 forsikringer. Udover min egen rejseforsikring, skal man være medlem af NHI (national health insurance). Dertil kom en studie forsikring.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: At spise ude er ca. halv pris af Danmark. Frugt er dyrt!

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg var medlem af en tennis cirkel (cirkel er mindre seriøst end klub i Japan). Jeg anbefaler helt klart at prøve en cirkel af - der er massere af forskellige slags!

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alle mulige slags. Fra brætspil til boldspil til danseklub. Dog snakker de ikke lige meget engelsk alle steder, men tag det som en oplevelse! :)

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Join en cirkel! 
Der er også en Japan café for folk der gerne vil øve japansk. Eller spørg IRIS (Information Room for International Students) - de har massere af gode tilbud.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er massere at se i Japan - du vælger nok bedst selv.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Den japanske kultur er noget anderledes, så man skal lige vænne sig til nogle ting.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join en cirkel, tag til japan café eller spørg IRIS.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nogle gange taler de engelsk til dig eller putter dig i kategorien udlænding uanset om du kan tale japansk eller ej...

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Folk er som regel meget venlige og høflige.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Hvis du er studerer Japanstudier og gerne vil blive bedre til Japansk kan det være en idé at undersøge om du kan komme udenom OUSSEP, eftersom de kun tilbyder japansk 3x om ugen og de fleste fag er på engelsk. 
Og kollegiet "global village" er fyldt med internationale studerende, så man kan få mange venner - både japanske og internationale, men du kommer nok mest til at tale engelsk...
"Global villlage" er lidt strengt  / rigid ift. ikke at larme, drikke alkohol, mødes med det modsatte køn på værelserne og så er det lidt dyrt, men man kan også få mange venner der, eftersom der bor mange elever.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Lad vær med spørg for meget om råd - gå på opdagelse og find selv ud af det, det er meget sjovere.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De venner jeg fik.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Sprogbarrieren.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: nej

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
